Table 2 costs are EUR2011 ('Costs (EUR2011)'); they are levelized production costs and are in a sidecar. Distribution and compression costs in the text and Table 1 state no year. The main file has NO money rows: the brief gives no production capex.

Main file: Table 2 efficiencies and typical sizes for steam methane reforming (steam-reformer_natural-gas), electrolysis (electrolyzer_electricity, with stack life in hours and the p.3 electricity range as a flow) and coal gasification (gasifier_coal); p.3 text for alkaline (efficiency, kWh/kg flow, size, pressure) and PEM (size) electrolysers; p.5 text for compression (10-15% of HHV as an electricity flow) and liquefaction (30-40%). No production capex exists in the brief; none is derived. Sidecars (not loaded): _no-archetype (partial oxidation; thermo-chemical and photo-electrolysis), _production-costs (levelized EUR2011/Nm3, cost breakdowns, price assumptions), _projections (2015/2020/2030), _other (the 'technical lifetime 2-5 years' cells, which are catalyst life, market shares, text efficiency conflict, reformer temperature), _distribution (Table 1 pipeline costs - levelized, no distance; compression and liquefaction costs; road delivery; blending limit). Omitted: fuel-cell vehicle storage and energy-storage systems (transport and power end uses).

(1) Table 2 'Technical lifetime 2 - 5 years' for SMR, POX and gasification is a catalyst or component life, not a plant life. (2) p.4 cost assumptions print an electricity cost of '0.8 EUR/MWh' - implausible. (3) Electrolysis efficiency 62-82% is said to equal 77-47 kWh/kg; 77 kWh/kg is about 51% on HHV. (4) Coal gasification efficiency 35-50% LHV (p.2) vs 50-70% (Table 2, p.1). (5) Electrolysis typical size 0.5-10 Nm3/h (Table 2) vs 1-1000 Nm3/h alkaline (p.1, p.3). (6) POX market share 30% matches refinery/chemical off-gas hydrogen in other IEA splits, not POX. (7) Table 2 uses thousands dots ('10.000 - 20.000', '40.000 hours') while its projection block uses commas ('40,000 hrs'). (8) Highlights print '0.13-015/kg'. (9) Table 1 pipeline costs give no distance or currency year. (10) Electrolysis efficiency projected for 2015 (50-80%) starts below the current 62-82%. (11) Footnote 2 contains a word-processor error string ('diffusionErrore. Il segnalibro non e definito.'). (12) Table 2's heating-value basis is not stated.
